checks.instructions: Exercise Tab, arrows, Space, mouse packet/card selection and launch, Backspace during a route and after a jam, R current-board retry, H guide, Escape pause, K/L save/load, F fullscreen. Check focus loss separately.

Inspect six-by-six flat board, packet counts and letters, sockets, first-impact clockwise preview, numbered impacts, all terminal messages and guide at 800x450 and 1280x720. Check no clipped or overlapping labels.
Solve teaching boards and an interacting board deliberately. Confirm a deposited bead redirects a later packet, and only deposits fill sockets. Assess route readability and pacing.
Listen to shared impact, jam and clear cues. Verify M toggles sound and Escape pauses audio. Software muted captures do not attest audible output.
